items.title: 3 consumer stocks we keep off our radar
items.summary: Regarded as defensive investments, consumer staples stocks are generally safe bets in choppy markets. The flip side is that they frequently fall behind growth industries when times are good, and this was the reality over the past six months as the sector’s 1% return has trailed the S&P 500 by 6.1 percentage points.

items.title: MDLZ Q3 deep dive: disciplined pricing and emerging market expansion drive optimism
items.summary: Packaged snacks company Mondelez (NASDAQ:MDLZ) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 2.3% year on year to $9.97 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.78 per share was 10.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
